title: Watch manatees at Three Sisters Springs
description: On a cool morning in Crystal River, follow the boardwalk above Three Sisters Springs and look into clear, blue-green water. Manatees gather in this warm-water refuge when surrounding waters turn cold; some rest almost motionless, while others surface for air. It is a patient, land-based way to watch wild animals without entering their protected space.
teaser: Look down into clear spring water for wintering manatees.
whyItMightDelightYou: The first slow shape beneath the surface can make the whole boardwalk fall quiet.
goodToKnow: Winter gatherings vary with the weather. Confirm current viewing access and shuttle arrangements. The idea is to watch from land, without swimming.
